title: Keep the signed-in feed greeting on the member's practice day

verify.note: Checks UTC and Pacific at the same midnight boundary and UTC fallback for missing or invalid zones.

detail: The signed-in feed greeting used Pacific community time while the practice chart used the member's saved timezone. Near midnight they displayed different days. The greeting now uses the same saved-zone and UTC fallback policy and the same instant as the chart. Production verification remains a release step.
